notes.title: Demo Speedrun Challenge
notes.content:
Hey Sword Masters,



I’m challenging you all to a race in the GIGASWORD demo for prizes!



To enter, record your gameplay of beating the demo and submit your entry in the #gigasword-demo-speedruns in the Akupara Games Discord.




The prizes are Steam keys for one of our titles of your choice and GIGASWORD Steam key when the game is released!




We will be doing a drawing after the event for the prizes plus the fastest time to beat the demo the fastest will also get the prize. 




You can gain multiple entries with one submission! 
[olist]
Submitting a speedrun (1+ entry) | Only the first submission gets the entry. 

Beat the demo in 30 minutes (+1 entry)

Beat the demo in 25 minutes (+1 entry)

Beat the demo in 20 minutes (+1 entry)

Top 5 times (+2 entry)
[/olist]



Couple rules for the speedrun demo!

Time starts once you gain control of your character and time ends once you defeat the boss

Glitches are allowed

Must provide a video of your run

You can submit multiple runs but only your best run will count

You must be a member of the Akupara Discord server 

I will close #gigasword-demo-speedruns for submissions on June 30th. 



Grab your Gigaswords and get through the demo as quickly as possible!

[dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/1885930/GIGASWORD/"][/dynamiclink] 
- Riv Otter

notes.title: May Monthly Dev Log - Multiple Awards in PAX East
notes.content:
Hey Sword Masters,

GIGASWORD participated in PAX East with a demo of GIGASWORD! Jack, the developer of GIGASWORD, was at PAX East and they had an amazing time there. You know what, I’ll have him say how PAX East went.

Hey giga-friends!

Pax East has come and gone, and what an amazing four days it was! A couple of highlights:

 I met my friends from Akupara!!
 we had a CONSTANT LINE to play the demo???
 I dressed up as Ezra
 I got invited to showcase the game…at a rave?
 Saw a bunch of familiar faces
 Met some IRL Kickstarter backers!!
 And last but certainly not least: GIGASWORD won FIVE Best In Show awards.


I am so humbled by all the praise that GIGASWORD received this past weekend. I want to give a massive thank you to everyone who stopped by the booth to play the demo; it was so nice meeting all of you, and I’m so glad you enjoyed the game! I also want to thank my friends here at Akupara; they put together an amazing booth, and I couldn’t be happier with the way it turned out. Lastly, thanks to all my fans and supporters who have helped GIGASWORD get this far. This game wouldn’t be what it is today without all of you.

Well, it’s back to work for me! I can’t wait for you to all get to play the full version of GIGASWORD soon. Thanks again for sticking by me on this journey. I love you all very much!

We couldn’t be any prouder of Jack, his accomplishments, and the team had a wonderful time being with you in support of GIGASWORD!

If you missed GIGASWORD at PAX East, don’t fret, there is a demo available for you to try on Steam!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1885930/GIGASWORD/ 
May I also recommend joining the GIGASWORD Discord as well?

- Riv Otter

notes.title: Akupara Games Reveals Gigasword
notes.content:
Hey sword masters,

My name is Joseph and I am the community manager for Akupara Games. I’m super excited to announce that Akupara Games has partnered up with Studio Hybrid to publish Gigasword!

[previewyoutube=8wElOVdFozw;full][/previewyoutube]

Gigasword is an adventure metroidvania where you must balance the weight of the Gigasword on your adventure. The Gigasword is not only great for slashing your enemies but also allows you to unlock doors and push down pressure plates. However with the weight of carrying such a huge sword does come with the downside of your movement being impacted. Will you be able to conquer the rooms that lay ahead of you?

Check out the demo and if you enjoy it, please wishlist Gigasword!

I can’t wait to reveal more of Gigasword but for now my adventure ends right here. Hope to see you in the next set of rooms.

- Riv otter
